title: Pan-Seared Irish Pork Chops with Porcini Mushrooms
description: A hearty and flavorful dish that combines the richness of Irish pork chops with the earthy taste of porcini mushrooms.
instructions: Season the pork chops with salt and pepper.
Heat the zesty olive oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the pork chops for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until browned.
Remove the pork chops from the skillet and set aside to rest.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the porcini mushrooms to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes, until tender.
Serve the pork chops with the porcini mushrooms and garlic sauce.
Cook the pork chops to an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare, 160°F (71°C) for medium, and 170°F (77°C) for well-done.
